papers.title: Smart-Insertion-V: Photorealistic Video Insertion via a Closed-Loop Feedback Dual-Stream Framework
papers.authors: Xiao Cao, Yansong Qu, Xiangzhen, Chang, Wen Xiao, Jiakui Hu, Heyuan Li, Jialun Liu, Zhiyong Huang, Xuelong Li
papers.intro: 本文提出Smart-Insertion-V，一个基于闭循环反馈的双流框架，通过同步进行视频插入和图像风格迁移，并结合解耦引导模块和双视角Rotary Position Encoding，实现了无掩码的、风格和谐的参考物体视频插入。

papers.title: HorizonStream: Long-Horizon Attention for Streaming 3D Reconstruction
papers.authors: Chong Cheng, Peilin Tao, Nanjie Yao, Guanzhi Ding, Xianda Chen, Yuansen Du, Xiaoyang Guo, Wei Yin, Weiqiang Ren, Qian Zhang, Zhengqing Chen, Hao Wang
papers.tags: 3D reconstruction, depth estimation, pose estimation, autonomous driving
papers.intro: 本文提出HorizonStream，通过将几何传播形式化为“证据影响核”并显式分解为长程时间因子和短程空间因子，利用通道级衰减率和有界局部注意力，实现48帧训练即可稳定泛化至超过10,000帧的在线3D重建。

papers.title: PGT: Procedurally Generated Tasks for improving visual grounding in MLLMs
papers.authors: Rim Assouel, Amir Bar, Michal Drozdzal, Adriana Romero-Soriano
papers.tags: multimodal learning, visual grounding, scene understanding, CLIP
papers.affiliations: Mila - Québec AI Institute / Université de Montréal / FAIR at Meta Superintelligence Labs / McGill University / Canada CIFAR AI Chair
papers.intro: 本文提出程序化生成任务（PGT），通过在真实图像上叠加抽象几何图元（如彩色边框、点、圆圈）生成密集可验证的监督信号，强制模型进行视觉定位，显著提升MLLMs在细粒度空间理解上的表现，并证明许多空间推理缺陷源于训练信号不足而非架构限制。

papers.title: LaMo: Self-Supervised Latent Motion Priors for Physical Realism in Video Generation
papers.authors: Bo Jiang, Depu Meng, Yihan Hu, Yichen Xie, Tianshuo Xu, Wei Zhan
papers.affiliations: Applied Intuition; University of California, Berkeley
papers.intro: LaMo提出了一种自监督的潜在运动先验，通过从无标签视频中提取帧间潜在变化来提升视频扩散模型的物理真实性，无需外部物理知识，并通过训练时的运动漂移损失和采样时的运动先验指导两条轻量级路径实现。

papers.title: Vision Transformers Need Better Token Interaction
papers.authors: Linxiang Su
papers.tags: semantic segmentation, depth estimation, image classification, vision transformer
papers.intro: 论文揭示ViT中密集退化源于“语义扩散”（semantic diffusion）这一优化捷径，并提出用entmax-1.5稀疏注意力替代softmax注意力，在保持全局连接的同时增强令牌交互选择性，从而在不牺牲图像级识别性能的前提下显著提升密集预测（尤其语义分割）效果。

papers.title: Leveraging Foundation Models for Causal Generative Modeling
papers.authors: Aneesh Komanduri, Xintao Wu
papers.intro: 本文提出FM-CGM——一个利用预训练推理VLM和文本到图像扩散模型进行零样本视觉因果推理的模块化框架，通过因果语义引导（CSG）实现忠实的反事实图像生成。

papers.title: RE-TRIANGLE: Does TRIANGLE Enable Multimodal Alignment Beyond Cosine Similarity in Retrieval?
papers.authors: Arijit Ghosh, Aritra Bandyopadhyay, Chiranjeev Bindra, Jingfen Qiao
papers.intro: 本文通过系统复现实验验证了TRIANGLE几何对齐目标在多模态检索中的有效性，确认其在零样本视频和音频检索上优于成对基线，但发现该目标对领域分布敏感、从头训练不稳定、且不同评估指标下表现不一致。

papers.title: CaST-Bench: Benchmarking Causal Chain-Grounded Spatio-Temporal Reasoning for Video Question Answering
papers.authors: Mingfang Zhang, Jingjing Pan, Ashutosh Kumar, Rajat Saini, Mustafa Erdogan, Hsuan-Kung Yang, Caixin Kang, Yifei Huang, Yoichi Sato, Quan Kong
papers.tags: video segmentation, visual grounding, multimodal learning, video generation, video search
papers.affiliations: Woven by Toyota, The University of Tokyo
papers.intro: CaST-Bench是一个全新的视频问答基准，通过提供带时间戳和边界框轨迹的链式时空因果证据，首次实现了对视觉语言模型因果链接地时空推理能力的严格评估。

papers.title: CoReVAD: A Contextual Reasoning Framework for Training-Free Video Anomaly Detection
papers.authors: Hyeongmuk Lim, Youngbum Hur
papers.affiliations: Department of Industrial Engineering, Inha University, Incheon, Republic of Korea
papers.intro: CoReVAD提出一种基于单个冻结VLM的训练-free视频异常检测框架，通过局部响应清洗和全局上下文细化，直接生成异常分数与时间描述，实现高效且可解释的异常检测。

papers.title: Cambrian-P: Pose-Grounded Video Understanding
papers.authors: Jihan Yang, Zifan Zhao, Xichen Pan, Shusheng Yang, Junyi Zhang, Bingyi Kang, Hu Xu, Saining Xie
papers.affiliations: New York University, UC Berkeley, Meta FAIR
papers.intro: 本文提出 Cambrian-P，通过在视频多模态大模型中引入每帧可学习的相机位姿标记（camera tokens）和位姿回归头，实现了基于位姿的视频理解，在空间推理VQA上获得显著提升，并作为副产物在实时位姿估计上达到最优。

papers.title: Cambrian-P: Pose-Grounded Video Understanding
papers.authors: Jihan Yang, Zifan Zhao, Xichen Pan, Shusheng Yang, Junyi Zhang, Bingyi Kang, Hu Xu, Shang-Wen Li, Saining Xie
papers.affiliations: New York University; UC Berkeley; Meta FAIR
papers.intro: Cambrian-P通过为视频MLLM引入逐帧可学习的相机姿态令牌和姿态回归头，以轻量级姿态监督显著提升了空间推理和通用视频QA性能，同时实现了流式相机姿态估计的最先进结果。

papers.title: MotiMotion: Motion-Controlled Video Generation with Visual Reasoning
papers.authors: Lee Hsin-Ying, Hanwen Jiang, Yiqun Mei, Jing Shi, Ming-Hsuan Yang, Zhixin Shu
papers.affiliations: University of California, Merced / Adobe Research
papers.intro: 本文提出MotiMotion，一个将运动控制重构为“推理‑生成”问题的框架，利用免训练的视觉语言模型（VLM）推理器细化稀疏用户输入并规划合理的次级运动，再通过置信度感知控制调节轨迹引导强度，从而生成因果一致、物理合理的交互视频。

papers.title: AwareVLN: Reasoning with Self-awareness for Vision-Language Navigation
papers.authors: Wenxuan Guo, Xiuwei Xu, Yichen Liu, Xiangyu Li, Hang Yin, Huangxing Chen, Wenzhao Zheng, Jianjiang Feng, Jie Zhou, Jiwen Lu
papers.intro: AwareVLN通过引入一种在关键导航节点触发的结构化自我意识推理机制和自动数据引擎，使VLN模型在保持端到端数据驱动的同时，具备显式的进度感知、错误修正和可解释规划能力，显著超越现有方法。

papers.title: Sensor2Sensor: Cross-Embodiment Sensor Conversion for Autonomous Driving
papers.authors: Jiahao Wang, Bo Sun, Yijing Bai, Vincent Casser, Songyou Peng, Zehao Zhu, Meng-Li Shih, Xander Masotto, Shih-Yang Su, Kanaad V Parvate, Tiancheng Ge, Linn Bieske, Dragomir Anguelov, Mingxing Tan, Chiyu Max Jiang
papers.affiliations: Waymo（主要），合作机构包括Johns Hopkins University, Google DeepMind, University of Washington
papers.intro: Sensor2Sensor 提出一种跨实体传感器转换范式，利用4D Gaussian Splatting重建AV日志生成配对训练数据，再使用条件扩散模型同时生成多视角图像和LiDAR，从而将野外单目行车记录仪视频转换为高保真多模态传感器日志。

papers.title: DecQ: Detail-Condensing Queries for Enhanced Reconstruction and Generation in Representation Autoencoders
papers.authors: Tianhang Wang, Yitong Chen, Wei Song, Zuxuan Wu, Min Li, Jiaqi Wang
papers.affiliations: Zhejiang University, Shanghai Innovation Institute, Fudan University, Westlake University, JD.COM
papers.intro: DecQ通过在冻结VFM的中间层上附加少量可学习查询（detail-condensing queries），经交叉注意力提取浅层和深层细粒度特征，在几乎不增加计算开销的前提下，同时显著提升重建质量和生成性能，解耦了RAE中固有的重建-生成权衡。

papers.title: WorldKV: Efficient World Memory with World Retrieval and Compression
papers.authors: Jung Yi, Minjae Kim, Paul Hyunbin Cho, Wooseok Jang, Sangdoo Yun, Seungryong Kim
papers.intro: 本文提出WorldKV，一种无需训练的框架，通过世界检索（基于相机/动作相关性有效召回历史KV缓存）和世界压缩（基于键-键相似性修剪冗余标记）两个组件，在保持实时推理吞吐量的同时匹配或超越全KV缓存的长期记忆保真度。

papers.title: Conceptualizing Embeddings: Sparse Disentanglement for Vision-Language Models
papers.authors: Piotr Kubaty, Patryk Marszałek, Łukasz Struski, Adam Wróbel, Jacek Tabor, Marek Śmieja
papers.affiliations: Jagiellonian University, Warsaw University of Technology
papers.intro: 提出CEDAR，一种无需增加维度、通过可逆变换与top-k稀疏瓶颈对预训练视觉语言嵌入进行后处理解耦的方法，使语义信息集中到轴对齐的少量坐标上，兼顾重建保真度与人类可解释性。

papers.title: Slimmable ConvNeXt: Width-Adaptive Inference for Efficient Multi-Device Deployment
papers.authors: Janek Haberer, Jon Eike Wilhelm, Olaf Landsiedel
papers.affiliations: Kiel University, Germany; Hamburg University of Technology (TUHH), Germany; UNU-INWEH, Germany
papers.intro: 论文提出Slimmable ConvNeXt，利用ConvNeXt的现代设计（层归一化和反转瓶颈结构）实现无需可切换归一化的宽度自适应推理，在ImageNet-1k上以更低的计算量（GMACs）达到超越现有ViT和CNN可扩展方法的精度。

papers.title: SEGA: Spectral-Energy Guided Attention for Resolution Extrapolation in Diffusion Transformers
papers.authors: Javad Rajabi, Kimia Shaban, Koorosh Roohi, David B. Lindell, Babak Taati
papers.tags: text-to-image, image generation, Image Feature Extraction
papers.intro: 提出SEGA，一种无训练、内容感知的动态注意力缩放方法，通过在每个去噪步骤分析潜变量的空间-频谱结构来逐维度调节RoPE缩放，从而同时改善高分辨率生成的结构连贯性和细节保真度。

papers.title: What Does the Caption Really Say? Counterfactual Phrase Intervention for Compositional Data Selection in Vision-Language Pretraining
papers.authors: Hyejin Go, Semi Lee, Hyesong Choi
papers.affiliations: Soongsil University, Seoul, Republic of Korea
papers.intro: 本文提出Counterfactual Phrase Intervention（CPI），一种短语级别的数据筛选框架，通过受控的非词替换生成图像条件下的短语敏感度分数，用于从全局对齐池中选择短语级支持更强的图文对，在不修改目标函数的情况下提升组合性预训练效果。
